purpose: Corrected SB_003 prompt-contract delta so the visible-speaker lip-sync rule (GOAL.md) becomes INAPPLICABLE during the measured spoken interval, without a paid call and without disturbing the post-mux exact-line audio lane. This is a PROPOSAL. No frames are regenerated by this file; regeneration is a human-gated follow-up.

sb_003_start_frame_contract.change: NONE - retained as the identity anchor (Kai's face readable).

invariant_preserved.story_intent: Kai reads the local, the channel, the reef, and Embry's paddle cadence; he holds position instead of taking the easy wave and gives one restrained cue; Embry absorbs it without surrendering the decision. Unchanged.
invariant_preserved.identity_requirements: Both Embry and Kai remain required and reference-verifiable. Kai's identity is anchored by the unchanged start frame and by wardrobe/hair/build continuity in the end frame. Only Kai's LIPS-camera-readability during the ~2.7s spoken window is removed.
invariant_preserved.canonical_line: If we paddle now, we're cutting across the lineup. (unchanged; still post-muxed at 5.0-7.7s with the consented Kai voice and PASSING forced alignment)

after.note: Kai must still read as the same person (wardrobe, hair, build, and a three-quarter-away head that does not expose readable lips). Full frontal face is no longer required for the end frame because identity is proven by the start frame.

prompt_sections.SUBJECT.before: sb_003 end frame from the interrupted stolen-sick-day surf story: Two-character lineup panel with Kai slightly outside and Embry closer to the decision point.
prompt_sections.SUBJECT.after: sb_003 end frame: Two-character lineup panel; Kai, slightly outside, delivers his one restrained cue while looking OUT toward the lineup and reef he is reading, so his head is three-quarter-away from camera and his lips are not camera-readable; Embry, closer to the decision point, keeps agency and faces the camera/decision.

sb_003_end_frame_delta.prompt_sections.CHARACTERS_addendum: Kai is mid-cue with his head turned toward the lineup/reef (three-quarter back-to-camera) and/or mid-paddle stroke with forearm and spray across his lower face; his mouth is NOT clearly readable to camera during this frame. Embry's face stays readable.

prompt_sections.MUST_NOT_INCLUDE_delta.remove_for_kai_only: the 'no back-facing-only or distant tiny faces; no occluded faces' clause is relaxed FOR KAI ONLY to permit a three-quarter-away head and mouth not camera-readable during the spoken cue. It still forbids Kai being a tiny distant figure, unrecognizable, identity-swapped, or omitted.
prompt_sections.MUST_NOT_INCLUDE_delta.retain_for_embry: Embry must remain readable, foreground, not back-facing, not occluded.

sb_003_end_frame_delta.camera_contract_addendum: MWS two-shot preserved; gentle lateral drift; frame Kai's cue on the turn toward the lineup so his lips are away from lens during 5.0-7.7s while Embry stays camera-readable.
sb_003_end_frame_delta.kling_segment_motion_prompt_addendum: For the sb_003 5.0-7.7s window: Kai turns his head toward the lineup and reef as he gives the restrained cue (lips away from lens), optionally a single paddle stroke bringing forearm/spray across the lower face; he does not turn fully back-to-camera and remains identity-recognizable; Embry holds and absorbs.

steps: Regenerate ONLY sb_003.end_frame via GPT Image 2 on the existing scillm image lane using the delta above (identity references: embry_contact_sheet_v3 + kai_akana_character_sheet, unchanged).
Actual-pixel identity review of the new end frame at the Phase C reviewer bar (Kai identity-recognizable despite three-quarter-away head; Embry readable).
Continuity re-review of the pairs sb_003_start -> sb_003_end (new) and sb_003_end (new) -> sb_004_start.

Re-hash the sb_003.end_frame panel_prompt_contract.v2 and re-bind it in the revision artifact index; mark the prior end-frame contract/frame superseded via the sanctioned supersession path (scripts/revision_supersession.py).
Carry the new speaker_mouth_camera_readable_during_speech=false field into the compiled successor provider request and the per-segment Kling motion prompt.

step38_acceptance_after_this_change: On the eventual Kling return, visible_speaker_lipsync_review.v1 should record observations.speaker_mouth_visible=false (or not camera-readable) across the measured 5.0-7.7s interval, yielding a PASS_VISIBLE_SPEAKER_RULE_INAPPLICABLE: post-mux audio is sufficient because the speaker's mouth is not readable during the measured speech (GOAL.md Completion Rule).

proves: A minimal, story-true SB_003 end-frame delta exists that removes the visible-speaker requirement for the spoken interval while preserving identity and story intent.
The change scope is bounded to one regenerated frame plus two continuity re-reviews and a per-segment motion-prompt update, with zero paid calls and no audio change.
does_not_prove: That the regenerated end frame will pass identity + continuity review (verified only after the human-approved regeneration).
That Kling will render the turn-away motion faithfully in the 5.0-7.7s window (verified only on the return).
